summary: Add Python dependencies to a pipx Ansible with pipx inject (with --include-apps to expose their commands), or install from a requirements file with pipx runpip, for example for the Azure collection.
questions: How do I install extra Python packages into a pipx Ansible?
How do I install the Azure collection's Python requirements with pipx?
How do I make an injected package's commands available on PATH?

answer_card.title: Add Python deps to a pipx Ansible
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
pipx inject ansible argcomplete
pipx inject --include-apps ansible argcomplete   # also put its commands on PATH
pipx runpip ansible install -r ~/.ansible/collections/ansible_collections/azure/azcollection/requirements.txt
```
